title: Preemptive mechanical circulatory support in ventricular tachycardia ablation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.

answer.design_quote: The certainty of evidence was very low, reflecting the observational study design, baseline imbalance between groups, and heterogeneity; these findings do not preclude the selective use of MCS in high-risk patients and require confirmation in randomized trials.
